prompt.alinti: Do not open Claude again until you install these four MCPs, because these are going to instantly make your Claude ten times more powerful.

Number one is Perplexity. This connects Claude to the best AI research model that exists. So instead of guessing what it knows from memory, it's going to pull real live data off the internet, and it's going to cite everything it gives you with sources.

Number two is Blotato. This connects Claude to every one of your social media accounts. And this lets you do things like post, repurpose, and pull analytics on any one of your content pieces. And they just dropped a comment to DM automation feature. So now you can just tell Claude, 'when someone comments this keyword on my post, send them this link.' And it's going to build and run the entire automation for you. You don't have to pay for ManyChat and you can do all this inside of Claude.

Number three is Higgsfield. This connects Claude to every single AI video and image and model in one place. You can ask it for things like a thumbnail, a product shot, or for an entire ad. And it's going to make it right there for you inside of the chat.

Number four is Composio. This connects Claude to hundreds of apps that you already use. Things like your Gmail, Notion, Slack, or your calendar. And the best part about Composio is that it does all of this inside of just one connector. That way you can manage all of your different tool connections in one place.
If you want the exact setup guide for all four of these and the best prompts to use with each one, comment MCP and I'll send it to you.
